title: Apply the accepted /todo cleanup (reject 184 Asks + 61 review items, complete 8 fixture Projects)
problem: On 2026-10-10 you accepted the /todo bulk disposition (Ask "Dismiss 286 superseded/off-path items", settlement dashboard-approve-agentask_0e5f4be24acb0e6e21-1791667137632; list docs/reports/todo-bulk-disposition-2026-10-10.json, sha256 813e83eaa4068a86b2bf1a5c088938c293e0bdf4aacfd500450fa418556916a4). Agents cannot apply it: rejecting Asks, rejecting review items and completing Projects are your acts, so the list sits unapplied and /todo stays full of stale, superseded and fixture items.
desired_effect: Rejects the 184 pinned pending Agent Asks (one recorded settlement each, request id bulk-20261010-<proposal>; the proposal and its content stay in the workspace), rejects the 61 listed open or deferred review items, and marks the 8 rehearsal fixture Projects completed (reversible with arcadia project update <id> --status active). Every item is re-checked just before it is applied; anything already settled, decided or changed is skipped and listed. The 41 cross-repo Asks (Private Practice Now, Mission Control Site, Rebuster) are skipped and listed for their own repositories. If a rejection archives a drafted Ask file, that commit lands on a fresh worktree branch, operator/todo-bulk-disposition-archives-20261010, which is pushed and opened as a pull request; nothing is committed on the main checkout. Preview read-only first: /Users/pmark/Dev/MR/Arcadia/arcadia/artifacts/generated/operator-scripts/apply-todo-bulk-disposition-20261010.sh --dry-run
preconditions: This script, its descriptor, the list, scripts/apply-todo-bulk-disposition.ts and its src modules are tracked, unmodified, and identical to origin/main in the Arcadia checkout
The list's sha256 is 813e83eaa4068a86b2bf1a5c088938c293e0bdf4aacfd500450fa418556916a4 and every declared proposal is one the list rejects
ARCADIA_WORKSPACE is not exported and the CLI default workspace is martianrover
~/tmp/arcadia-todo-bulk-disposition-20261010 is absent, or is a clean worktree of this repository on operator/todo-bulk-disposition-archives-20261010 (a resumed run)
expected_duration: About 2 to 10 minutes (245 settlements and decisions, one push and one pull request only if an Ask file needs archiving).
cost_note: No model use and no spend; local Arcadia writes, and at most one push and one pull request.

does: Refuses before any write unless this action's files are tracked, unmodified and identical to origin/main, the list's sha256 matches, the descriptor's declared proposals are all rejections the list makes, ARCADIA_WORKSPACE is not exported and the default workspace is martianrover

Runs under its own operator execution context, so Arcadia's settlement guard admits only disposition rejected and only for the 184 proposals pinned in agentAskRejections; any other settlement is refused by the canonical code, not by this script

For each pinned Agent Ask still pending: previews the canonical settlement (arcadia agent-ask settle, disposition rejected, request id bulk-20261010-<proposal>) and applies exactly that preview fingerprint; skips and records an Ask already settled, missing, refused by the preview, or whose rejection would archive a file on another repository's checkout
For each listed review item still open or deferred: arcadia review reject <id>; skips and records anything already decided

For each of the 8 pinned fixture Projects (proj_f9af573185984c4bb1 three-action-rehearsal, proj_6f9a48901eb64a849f two-action-rehearsal, proj_9492782cef794dda9d -v2, proj_bf52c629aa384f8493 -v3, proj_fbdbf9d73b2b40d79b -v4, proj_f9ccab08c6ad4d4298 -v5, proj_9f837e5188534af2b3 -v6, proj_fc0a2c56e3e7424c84 zero-prompt-rehearsal): verifies id, slug and its disposable ~/tmp/arcadia-<slug> repository, then arcadia project update <id> --status completed

Runs every settlement from a fresh worktree ~/tmp/arcadia-todo-bulk-disposition-20261010 (branch operator/todo-bulk-disposition-archives-20261010 from origin/main), so any Ask-file archive commit lands there; verifies each such commit is that worktree's HEAD and that the main checkout's HEAD never moves; pushes the branch without force and opens (or reuses) one pull request; removes the worktree and branch when nothing needed archiving
Resumes idempotently: a rerun re-checks every item and skips what is already applied, reuses the same settlement request ids and the existing archive worktree
--dry-run reads the live state, previews every settlement (no apply) and lists exactly what would happen, writing nothing to the workspace, any branch or GitHub
Writes runs/<timestamp-pid>/receipt.json, the per-item disposition-receipt.json and run.log, plus failure-handoff.md on failure
never_does: Never touches the 41 cross-repo Asks (Private Practice Now, Mission Control Site, Rebuster) left out of the declared scope, and never commits on another repository's checkout

Never touches review items R366 (review_c1cc2f67b165454dab) or R368 (review_af4fe69f0faf47ad9b), PR #1212, PR #1033, the Ask pr-opened-arcadia-pr1212, the Ask pr-opened-arcadia-pr1033, PR #1178 or Issue #1177
Never accepts an Ask, settles one outside the pinned 184, or rejects an item whose state changed since the list; never approves or defers a review item
Never changes any Project, Plan, Action, pointer, queue or Decision beyond the rejections and the 8 fixture Project statuses
Never commits on the main checkout, force-pushes, rewrites history, merges a pull request or deletes anything other than its own empty archive worktree and branch
Never touches production, the go-broker, a Grant, a Session or any reset, G6, G7 or G8 receipt, and never restarts a service
Never closes or edits the fixture pull requests #1 to #10 (already closed) or any other pull request
Never edits the workspace database directly and never exports ARCADIA_WORKSPACE

success.effect: Every pinned item is either applied (rejected or completed) or skipped with a recorded reason; the per-item receipt lists each one, including the 41 cross-repo Asks left for their own repositories. /todo no longer shows the rejected items or the fixture Projects' leftovers. If any Ask file was archived, the receipt names the pull request carrying those archive commits.
success.next: Open /todo to confirm the cleanup. If the receipt names an archive pull request, it merges on the normal review gate. The 41 cross-repo Asks need their own disposition in their repositories.

failure.effect: The receipt and failure handoff name the stage and reason; the per-item receipt lists everything applied before it stopped. Nothing was forced, reset or deleted, no Ask was accepted, and production, the broker and Grants were not touched.
failure.next: Correct the named cause and press Retry; the rerun skips everything already applied and resumes under the same request ids and archive worktree.
